title: Refill Alignment Days — Medication Synchronization Note for Transition Fills
content:
Under the Pharmacy Benefit, a newly enrolled member's transition fill carries refill alignment days that depend on how recently the member's latest paid refill was filled.

**Rule.** The refill alignment days are three (3) where the member's latest paid refill of any drug was filled within the last seven (7) days, one (1) where it was filled eight to fourteen (14) days ago, and nothing otherwise.

The refill read is the member's latest paid fill of any drug that is a refill, on the member's pharmacy claims; its fill date is counted in calendar days to today. The alignment days are added to the transition fill days.

### Table

| Calendar days since the latest paid refill of any drug | Refill alignment days |
|---|---|
| 0 through 7 | 3 |
| 8 through 14 | 1 |
| 15 or more | Nothing |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Latest paid refill filled | Alignment days |
|---|---|
| 7 days ago | 3 |
| 8 days ago | 1 |
| 14 days ago | 1 |
| 15 days ago | Nothing |
